translationRepairs: Zeng De of Yuyang was the fifty-seventh-generation descendant of Confucius.
Zeng De of Yuyang was the fifty-seventh-generation descendant of the Duke of Zongsheng.
s0082 has 宗聖公五十七代孫: 宗聖公 is Zengzi's temple title, not Confucius; the proposed idiomatic correctly restores Duke of Zongsheng.
He died in the second year of Zhiyuantong—exactly twelve years later, as he had vowed.
He died in the second year of Yuantong—exactly twelve years later, as he had vowed.
s0100 has 至元統二年: 至 is the temporal verb "when it came to," and 元統 is the Yuantong reign; Zhiyuantong wrongly fuses them. Contrast s0102 至元二年, where Zhiyuan is the actual reign name.
In the second year of Zhiyuantong he died—indeed matching the count of one cycle.
In the second year of Yuantong he died—indeed matching the count of one cycle.
The literal field has the same fusion of 至 + 元統 into Zhiyuantong; Yuantong correctly names the reign in 至元統二年.
